findings: healthcare-revenue-cycle-management: commercial:waystar cites only https://www.waystar.com/, but the saved snapshot is a client-rendered HTML/CSS shell with no readable title, meta description, or product/category/workflow text. It does not substantiate that Waystar is a healthcare revenue cycle management platform. Replace it with an official source whose body proves the product type, or remove the leaf match/entry and record insufficient_evidence with the candidate, URL, query, and gap.
non_blocking_notes: gxp-training-management: Montrium Training Management is supported as a life-sciences role/event-based training module, but GxP version binding and per-person qualification evidence are not visible in the snapshot; the current reason text already narrows this and is acceptable for commercial basic truth.

health-plan-administration-system: HealthEdge source supports core administration/claims, but enrollment, eligibility, and benefit-configuration specifics are not visible; keep the reason text at the current high-level scope.
life-sciences-qms: QMSdesk is substantiated mainly by title/meta text on a minified page; keep the reason text limited to eQMS identification.
infection-prevention-platform: Prevexium source supports infection prevention and HAI surveillance; broader platform-core claims should remain product-level rather than over-specified.

leaf_checks.irt-rtsm: Medrio official page and JSON-LD support subject randomization, kit assignment, inventory tracking, and automated resupply.
leaf_checks.electronic-trial-master-file-etmf: Montrium official page and JSON-LD support TMF Reference Model structures, document indexing, completeness tracking, and inspection readiness.
leaf_checks.gxp-training-management: Montrium official page supports role/event-based training management for life-sciences teams; GxP-specific details are not visible but commercial basic type match is supported.
leaf_checks.healthcare-quality-management: MEG official page supports healthcare quality, accreditation readiness, incident reporting, CAPA, and audits.
leaf_checks.infection-prevention-platform: Prevexium official page supports infection prevention, HAI surveillance, EOC rounds, and survey readiness.
leaf_checks.life-sciences-qms: QMSdesk official homepage title/meta supports an eQMS for life sciences.
leaf_checks.medical-device-lifecycle-management: Greenlight Guru official page supports MedTech design controls, risk management, and traceability across the device lifecycle.
leaf_checks.medical-device-post-market-surveillance: Greenlight Guru official page supports post-market surveillance, complaints, CAPA, and quality events for medical devices.
leaf_checks.regulatory-information-management-rim: Veeva official page supports regulatory information management for registrations, submissions, and health authority correspondence.
leaf_checks.stability-study-management: SLIM official page supports stability study protocol design, time-point scheduling, sample pull management, and storage conditions.
leaf_checks.validation-management: MasterControl official page supports risk-based validation tools, protocols, and QA approvals for life sciences.
leaf_checks.health-plan-administration-system: HealthEdge official page supports payer/health-plan administration and core claims processing at a platform level.
leaf_checks.healthcare-revenue-cycle-management: Waystar entry is not supported by readable official-source text in the saved snapshot.
leaf_checks.patient-registration-intake: Phreesia official page supports patient intake, registration, insurance capture, and staff review.
leaf_checks.payer-care-management: ZeOmega official page supports payer care management, member stratification, and care coordination.
leaf_checks.payer-claims-processing: HealthEdge official page supports payer claims processing, adjudication, and payment settlement.
leaf_checks.practice-management-system: OpenEMR repository metadata and homepage support open-source EHR and practice management with scheduling.
leaf_checks.prior-authorization-platform: Availity official page supports transforming prior authorization and request status tracking.
leaf_checks.provider-claims-management: Correctly recorded as insufficient_evidence; OpenEMR snapshot does not substantiate charge capture, claim generation, submission, and A/R workflows.
leaf_checks.provider-network-management: Availity official page supports provider network collaboration and workflow automation.
leaf_checks.utilization-management: MCG official page and JSON-LD support utilization management criteria and clinical review determinations.
leaf_checks.value-based-care-platform: Innovaccer official page supports value-based care products and population health analytics.
leaf_checks.durable-medical-equipment-management: Brightree official page supports HME/DME software for orders, inventory, and billing.
leaf_checks.electronic-prescribing: OpenEMR homepage supports prescription creation and electronic sending to pharmacies.
leaf_checks.home-infusion-management: Brightree official page lists home infusion solutions among its HME and pharmacy software.

limits: Read-only review of the provided input.json, batch.json, research.json, and source snapshots; no files were written and no shell commands were run. The review was performed in the same model family as collection, so its independence is weaker than a cross-model review. No external source verification or validation command was executed.
